channel.title: World Soccer Talk - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from World Soccer Talk (worldsoccertalk.com)

item.title: Brazil legend Romario backs Neymar for 2026 World Cup, criticizes Carlo Ancelotti over list absence
item.description: After being excluded for the March friendlies, Brazil legend Romario backed Neymar's inclusion in the 2026 World Cup squad while also taking a jab to head coach Carlo Ancelotti.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo could return from injury as Al Nassr reportedly arrange friendly during FIFA break
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo could be making his return to the pitch in the coming days as Al Nassr have reportedly arranged a friendly game during the upcoming FIFA break.

item.title: Argentina star Enzo Fernandez reveals ‘no talks’ with Real Madrid as Chelsea exit reports grow
item.description: With rumors over a potential exit from Chelsea rising, Argentina star Enzo Fernandez revealed that he hasn't held talks with Real Madrid.

item.title: When is Lionel Messi’s next game? Inter Miami star called up for Argentina duty
item.description: With the 2026 MLS season already underway, questions are being raised about when Argentina and Inter Miami star Lionel Messi will play his next game.

item.title: Kylian Mbappé defends Real Madrid amid reported knee injury mishandling rumors: ‘There was a lot of speculation’
item.description: Although Kylian Mbappé has already returned from injury, the Frenchman may have had his knee at risk as Real Madrid reportedly mishandled his injury. In light of this, the 27-year-old striker decided to deny the information, defending los Blancos.

item.title: Lionel Messi’s MLS circle grows as another La Liga great and World Cup winner Antoine Griezmann joins Orlando City, but there’s a twist
item.description: While the headlines celebrate the blockbuster reunion of La Liga pedigree in MLS, there remains an intriguing layer beneath the surface that adds mystery to the deal.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo calms 2026 World Cup fears with positive four-word injury update as Al-Nassr return date approaches
item.description: Ronaldo has broken his silence with a brief but meaningful update, offering a glimpse into his recovery process

item.title: Real Madrid and Barcelona lose a main target as Nico Schlotterbeck reportedly nears a renewal with Borussia Dortmund
item.description: Following his strong performances, Nico Schlotterbeck had emerged as a main target for Real Madrid and Barcelona. However, the German has reportedly changed his stance, moving closer to a contract renewal with Borussia Dortmund.

item.title: Griezmann becomes 20th World Cup winner in MLS: Messi and Muller among them
item.description: The arrival of Antoine Griezmann at Orlando City adds another World Cup winner to MLS, following the path of Lionel Messi and Thomas Muller, among others.

item.title: AC Milan legend Andriy Shevchenko defends Rafael Leao amid criticism: ‘He’s not playing in his natural position’
item.description: While Rafael Leao ranks among AC Milan's top scorers, he faces constant criticism due to his inconsistency. In light of this, legend Andriy Shevchenko defended the Portuguese player, pointing out that he is not playing in his natural position.
